description: One of the most standard WYS decks ever
strategy:
This is a very standard deck.  Pull out the DBs and Kessel.  Stack at Kessel and Tatooine and retrieve with Celebration and on the edge.  Put  the Pt craft at the dbs and reacte away or whatever if it is necessary.  The Epps are in there for if you want to take out your opponent's characters.  I know there are lots of bullets for this deck, but in my experience, not many folks play them.  This is the first of a series of decks that I am building to force people in my area to use bullets for decks like these.  If you have any suggestions for how to make this deck more abusive towards multiple destinies and reacting away from battles, I'd like to hear them.  Here are a few side things that I decided not to use:

Podracing:  I want to start 3 effects and feel that it is not that necessary

Kessel Runs:  I've never been very good at getting out RFCs and stuff, plus I wanted to try something different.

I guese that's it.  It's really late and if I forgot something let me know.
